facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. On Đường Trần Hưng Đạo, between the beach bars and souvenir shops, sits a Guan Di Temple most visitors never notice. Red lanterns, incense smoke, silence. A real slice of Phu Quoc's Chinese-Vietnamese heritage that the resort brochures skip entirely. Go early morning. Go respectfully. Go. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
